note: Common ways people describe an anime they can't name, with the answer and the detail that gives it away. Each answer is a famous, well-documented premise; sources are the show's Wikipedia article.

groups.label: Reincarnated or trapped in another world

entries.q: A guy eats a strange fruit, his body turns to rubber and he wants to be king of the pirates
entries.clue: Monkey D. Luffy ate the Gum-Gum Fruit (a Devil Fruit), which made his body stretch like rubber but means he can't swim.

entries.q: A student finds a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it
entries.clue: Light Yagami picks up a death god's notebook and starts killing criminals, while the detective L hunts him.

entries.q: Humanity lives behind huge walls and a boy can turn into a giant to fight the giants
entries.clue: Eren Yeager discovers he can transform into a Titan after the walls protecting his town are breached.

entries.q: A boy eats a cursed finger and a powerful demon starts living inside his body
entries.clue: Yuji Itadori swallows one of Ryomen Sukuna's fingers, becomes Sukuna's host and joins a school of jujutsu sorcerers.

entries.q: A boy's family is killed by a demon, his sister becomes a demon, and he fights demons with a sword
entries.clue: Tanjiro Kamado joins the Demon Slayer Corps to cure his sister Nezuko, who travels with him in a wooden box.

entries.q: An orphan ninja with a fox demon sealed inside him wants to become the village leader
entries.clue: Naruto Uzumaki carries the Nine-Tailed Fox and dreams of becoming Hokage of the Hidden Leaf Village.

entries.q: Almost everyone has a superpower except one boy, who still wants to be a hero
entries.clue: Izuku Midoriya is born without a Quirk until the top hero, All Might, passes his own power on to him.

entries.q: A bald superhero defeats every enemy with a single punch and is bored
entries.clue: Saitama trained so hard he lost his hair and became so strong that no fight lasts more than one punch.

entries.q: Two brothers try to bring their mother back with alchemy; one loses his body and lives inside a suit of armour
entries.clue: Edward Elric lost an arm and a leg and his brother Alphonse's soul is bound to armour; they search for the Philosopher's Stone.

entries.q: A poor boy merges with his chainsaw dog and can grow chainsaws out of his head and arms
entries.clue: Denji fuses with his devil dog Pochita and becomes a devil hunter for the government.

entries.q: A boy with a fishing rod leaves his island to become a Hunter and find his father
entries.clue: Gon Freecss takes the Hunter Exam, befriends Killua and learns the power system called Nen.

entries.q: A boy born with no magic in a magic world gets a black grimoire with a five-leaf clover
entries.clue: Asta's five-leaf grimoire gives him anti-magic swords; he wants to become the Wizard King.

entries.q: A quiet middle-school boy with huge psychic powers keeps his emotions down until they hit 100%
entries.clue: Shigeo 'Mob' Kageyama works for a fake psychic, and his power explodes when his emotion meter reaches 100%.

entries.q: A spy builds a fake family; the adopted daughter can read minds and the wife is secretly an assassin
entries.clue: Loid Forger (codename Twilight) needs a family for a mission; Anya reads minds and Yor is the assassin Thorn Princess.

entries.q: An elf mage outlives the hero party she defeated the demon king with, and travels to understand them
entries.clue: Frieren starts the story after the adventure is over, when her human friend Himmel dies of old age.

entries.q: The weakest hunter in a world of monster dungeons starts levelling up like a video game character
entries.clue: Sung Jinwoo survives a deadly dungeon and gets a 'System' that only he can see, letting him level up without limit.

entries.q: A girl who believes in ghosts and a boy who believes in aliens both find out they're real
entries.clue: Momo Ayase and Okarun dare each other to visit a haunted tunnel and a UFO spot; Momo gets psychic powers and Okarun is cursed.

entries.q: A boy summoned to a fantasy world goes back in time every time he dies
entries.t: Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World
entries.clue: Subaru Natsuki's only power is 'Return by Death': he restarts from a checkpoint each time he is killed.

entries.q: A man is stabbed, dies and is reborn in a fantasy world as a slime
entries.t: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
entries.clue: Satoru Mikami becomes the slime Rimuru Tempest, who can absorb anything he eats and builds a nation of monsters.

entries.q: Thousands of players are trapped in a virtual reality game, and dying in the game kills you for real
entries.clue: Kirito and the other players can only log out by clearing all 100 floors of the game's castle, Aincrad.

entries.q: A gamer stays logged in when his game shuts down and is stuck as his skeleton overlord character
entries.clue: Momonga, an undead sorcerer later called Ainz Ooal Gown, rules the Great Tomb of Nazarick in a world that has become real.

entries.q: A guy dies in an embarrassing way and goes to a fantasy world with a useless goddess
entries.t: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!
entries.clue: Kazuma picks the goddess Aqua as his one item to bring; their party adds an explosion-obsessed mage and a masochist knight.

entries.q: A jobless man dies and is reborn as a baby in a magic world, keeping all his memories
entries.clue: Rudeus Greyrat uses his adult mind to master magic as a child and tries to live this second life properly.

entries.q: A guy summoned as one of four heroes only gets a shield, and is betrayed and falsely accused
entries.t: The Rising of the Shield Hero
entries.clue: Naofumi Iwatani is robbed and framed by his party member, then rebuilds with the slave girl Raphtalia.

entries.q: A girl is reborn as the villainess of a dating game and tries to avoid her bad endings
entries.t: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!
entries.clue: Catarina Claes remembers her past life after a bump on the head and sees that every route of the game ends in her exile or death.

entries.q: A high-school girl is reborn as a spider monster in a dungeon
entries.t: So I'm a Spider, So What?
entries.clue: She hatches as a small spider and survives by levelling up skills, told from her own sarcastic point of view.

entries.q: Two gamer siblings are pulled into a world where everything is decided by games
entries.clue: Sora and Shiro, known online as the unbeaten player 'Blank', are summoned to Disboard, where war is banned and games settle all disputes.

entries.q: A boy hides his real power and pretends to lead a secret shadow organisation, which turns out to be real
entries.clue: Cid Kagenou plays at being the mastermind 'Shadow', not knowing the evil cult he invented actually exists.

entries.q: Kids at a happy orphanage find out they are being raised as food for demons
entries.clue: Emma, Norman and Ray discover the truth about Grace Field House and plan an escape from their 'Mom'.

entries.q: A deaf girl and the boy who bullied her in primary school meet again as teenagers
entries.clue: Shoya Ishida tries to make amends with Shoko Nishimiya after bullying her left him isolated too.

entries.q: A boy and a girl swap bodies in their sleep, and there's a comet
entries.clue: Taki in Tokyo and Mitsuha in a country town keep waking up in each other's bodies before the comet Tiamat passes.

entries.q: A girl's parents turn into pigs and she has to work in a bathhouse for spirits
entries.clue: Chihiro works for the witch Yubaba under the name Sen to save her parents; the Studio Ghibli film won the Oscar for animated feature.

entries.q: Scientists send text messages into the past with a modified microwave
entries.clue: Rintaro Okabe's 'Phone Microwave (name subject to change)' lets his lab change the past, with dangerous results.

entries.q: Bounty hunters travel through space on a ship, with a jazz soundtrack
entries.clue: Spike Spiegel and Jet Black chase bounties on the ship Bebop; the music is by Yoko Kanno.

entries.q: A teenage boy is forced by his father to pilot a giant robot against monsters called Angels
entries.clue: Shinji Ikari pilots Evangelion Unit-01 for the agency NERV, run by his father Gendo.

entries.q: An exiled prince gets the power to make anyone obey one command and leads a rebellion in a mask
entries.t: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
entries.clue: Lelouch receives the Geass from the witch C.C. and becomes the masked rebel Zero against the Britannian Empire.

entries.q: A girl who knows medicine and poisons is sold to the imperial palace and solves mysteries there
entries.clue: Maomao, an apothecary's daughter, is noticed by the eunuch Jinshi after she works out why the emperor's babies are falling ill.

entries.q: A college student gets organs from a monster after an accident and becomes half human, half ghoul
entries.clue: Ken Kaneki survives a ghoul attack through a transplant and now has to eat human flesh to live.

entries.q: A guy goes back 12 years in time to save his ex-girlfriend from a biker gang
entries.clue: Takemichi Hanagaki time-leaps to his middle-school days and joins the Tokyo Manji Gang to change Hinata's fate.

entries.q: A student at an elite school hides how smart he is and is put in the lowest class
entries.clue: Kiyotaka Ayanokoji quietly manipulates events in Class D of the Advanced Nurturing High School.

entries.q: Two genius students are in love but each tries to make the other confess first
entries.clue: Kaguya Shinomiya and Miyuki Shirogane, the student council vice president and president, turn romance into a battle of wits.

entries.q: Kids climb down into a giant pit full of monsters to find a mother who went missing there
entries.clue: Riko and the robot boy Reg descend into the Abyss, where coming back up causes a deadly curse.

entries.q: Everyone in the world is turned to stone, and a science genius wakes up thousands of years later
entries.clue: Senku Ishigami sets out to rebuild civilisation from scratch using science.

entries.q: A Viking boy joins the warriors who killed his father so he can get revenge
entries.clue: Thorfinn fights for Askeladd for years hoping to duel him, in 11th-century Europe.

entries.q: A doctor is reborn as the child of his favourite pop idol and investigates her murder
entries.clue: Aqua and Ruby are reborn as the twins of the idol Ai Hoshino and enter show business after her death.

entries.q: A man who cleans up after monster attacks can turn into a monster himself
entries.clue: Kafka Hibino, 32, swallows a small kaiju, becomes Kaiju No. 8 and still tries to join the Defence Force.

entries.q: A teenager with orange hair and a huge sword gets the powers of a Soul Reaper
entries.clue: Ichigo Kurosaki takes Rukia Kuchiki's Soul Reaper powers and fights evil spirits called Hollows.

entries.q: A short boy who jumps very high joins his high-school volleyball team
entries.clue: Shoyo Hinata teams up with the genius setter Tobio Kageyama at Karasuno High.

entries.q: A basketball player nobody notices passes the ball like he's invisible
entries.clue: Tetsuya Kuroko, the 'phantom sixth man' of the Generation of Miracles, uses his low presence to make impossible passes.

entries.q: Strikers are locked in a training facility and compete to become Japan's best footballer
entries.clue: Yoichi Isagi is one of 300 forwards in Ego Jinpachi's 'Blue Lock' programme, where losers are dropped from the national team for good.

entries.q: A piano prodigy stops hearing his own playing after his mother dies, until he meets a free-spirited violinist
entries.clue: Kosei Arima returns to music because of Kaori Miyazono.

entries.q: A very shy girl who plays guitar alone in her room joins a band
entries.clue: Hitori 'Bocchi' Gotoh is a skilled online guitarist with crippling social anxiety who joins the Kessoku Band.

entries.q: A blue robot cat from the future helps a lazy boy with gadgets from his pocket
entries.clue: Doraemon is sent back in time to help Nobita Nobi; in India it airs in Hindi on Disney Channel and streams on JioHotstar.

entries.q: A naughty five-year-old boy embarrasses his mother everywhere
entries.clue: Shinnosuke 'Shin-chan' Nohara lives in Kasukabe with his family and dog Shiro; it's one of the most-watched kids' shows in Hindi.

entries.q: A teenage detective is shrunk into a child by a poison and keeps solving murders
entries.clue: Shinichi Kudo calls himself Conan Edogawa while he hunts the Black Organization that poisoned him.

entries.q: A boy travels with a yellow electric mouse catching monsters in balls
entries.clue: Ash Ketchum and Pikachu travel to become a Pokémon Master; the original series began in 1997.

entries.q: A boy with a monkey tail searches for seven magic balls that grant a wish
entries.clue: Young Goku meets Bulma and hunts the Dragon Balls; the story continues in Dragon Ball Z.
